what: Fixed RF carriers masked by REDUCE's RFI MASK (opt-in, reduce_rfi_mask.py) on every capture, frequency-switched or not: bins within frequency_hz +/- half_width_hz get MaskFlag.KNOWN_SPUR (flagged, never filled). Add a line only after it was seen in many captures.

lines.evidence: 2026-11-10 bench FS run (400 points, LNA without antenna): in 400/400 points, peak +70..+340 %, centre 1420.03954-1420.04013 MHz, wings to +/-1 kHz. Steady carrier: spectral kurtosis does not flag it. Origin unknown (internal / near field). Sits at ~+77 km/s topocentric.
